name: presentation
description: Slide deck from a topic/outline: self-contained HTML slides (keyboard/print) + slide outline markdown
goal: Build a {slides}-slide presentation on: {topic} for a {audience} audience. Outline: {outline}. Style: {style}.
constraints: Output slides.html: ONE self-contained file (inline CSS/JS, no external requests, fonts, CDNs or frameworks), one <section> per slide, arrow keys/space to navigate, slide counter, and a print stylesheet that puts one slide per page (so the owner can Save as PDF). Also write slides.md (per slide: title, bullets, speaker notes). Max ~6 bullets per slide, readable at 16:9. Do not invent statistics, quotes or data; if the topic needs facts that were not provided, put a visible [SOURCE NEEDED] marker instead. Visuals via inline SVG/CSS only.
done_when: slides.html exists, is standalone (no http/https resource URLs), has exactly {slides} slide sections with keyboard navigation and a print stylesheet; slides.md has the same {slides} slides with speaker notes; no unsourced statistics.
